d: Some careers shine brighter than others.
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

The Markets & Securities Services (MSS) division in CIB plays a critical role in facilitating access to financial markets and managing associated risks. MSS Operations, MENA has the following Product Support teams – GFX, Fixed Income & Rates, Equities & Collateral and Cross Product Services.

We are currently seeking an ambitious individual to join our MSS Institutional Sales team, who will support the coverage of institutional clients across Prime Services and Equity Derivatives products. The role identifies client needs and sales opportunities, provides relevant market information and HSBC content, supports transaction execution, and collaborates with Trading, Structuring, Research, Relationship Managers and control functions.
r: Manage day-to-day relationships with institutional clients, understanding their investment objectives, portfolio strategies, financing requirements and product needs.
Identify and develop business opportunities across Prime Services, Equity Derivatives, Cash Equities, Financing and Securities Services.
Support the marketing, pricing and execution of equity derivative, financing and prime-services transactions, including options, futures, swaps and structured solutions.
Provide clients with relevant market intelligence, trade ideas, research, trader axes, structured solutions and HSBC content.
Collaborate with Sales, Trading, Structuring, Research, Securities Services, Operations, Relationship Managers and other internal teams to deliver effective client solutions.
Coordinate order handling, trade capture, confirmations, margin, collateral, settlement and other post-trade requirements.
Follow approved procedures for client onboarding, suitability, order handling, communications and record keeping, while identifying and escalating risks and control issues.
Support senior colleagues, share client and market intelligence, build strong stakeholder relationships and contribute to an inclusive, high-performing team culture.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Relevant experience in Prime Services, Equity Derivatives Sales, Equity Sales, Financing Sales or a related Global Markets role, preferably covering MENAT markets.
Strong knowledge of cash equities, equity options, futures, swaps, structured products, securities lending, margin financing and portfolio financing.
Understanding of transaction execution, trade lifecycle management, clearing, settlement, collateral and other post-trade processes.
Experience managing relationships with institutional clients, including hedge funds, asset managers, family offices, banks and other financial-market participants.
Strong communication, relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain market developments and develop client-focused solutions.

Good understanding of Front Office risk, governance, conduct and control requirements, supported by strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively under pressure.
A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa/work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory

Under the New Labour Law, only fixed term contracts shall be available to all employees of HSBC UAE (except DIFC and ADGM employees) – hence in line with the term of work permit, a 4 years’ contract would be issued.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

d: We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we're looking for a Network Engineer who can help us move even faster.

Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG and grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
q: 5–7 years of experience in IT Network Infrastructure, preferably within a Cisco environment.
3–5 years of experience in Windows and Linux server administration.
Strong knowledge of Cisco routers, firewalls, wireless controllers, and switches.
Hands-on experience with Cisco SD-WAN, routing, switching, VPN, and NAC.
Experience administering Cisco Meraki and TP-Link Omada.
Knowledge of Azure cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure.
Experience with network monitoring tools such as Zabbix, NetFlow, and ManageEngine.
Familiarity with network automation and infrastructure optimization.
Knowledge of IP Address Management (IPAM) and network documentation.
Understanding of network wireless technologies and telephony infrastructure.
CCNA Routing and Switching and Security certification.
CCNP Routing and Switching or CCNP Enterprise certification (ENCOR / SCOR).
Relevant cloud certifications, particularly Microsoft Azure, are an advantage.
We’re looking for people with high standards who understand that hard work matters.
You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
Noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.
r: Noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward.

The Network Engineer will be responsible for managing, securing, and optimizing noon's network and IT infrastructure across multiple environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability of network, server, and cloud services.
Manage and maintain Cisco network infrastructure, including routers, firewalls, wireless controllers, and Layer 2 switches.
Administer Cisco Meraki and TP-Link Omada networking solutions.
Manage network security, routing, switching, VPN, NAC, and Cisco SD-WAN technologies.
Oversee network infrastructure upgrades, implementations, migrations, and capacity planning.
Manage Cisco licensing, renewals, security subscriptions, and SmartNet contracts.
Support Windows and Linux server administration, including configuration, patching, troubleshooting, and failover clustering.
Support Azure cloud networking, including Local Network Gateways and Virtual WAN technologies.
Collaborate with cloud and application teams to secure hybrid and cloud environments.
Monitor network performance using tools such as Zabbix, NetFlow, and ManageEngine.
Develop and implement network automation processes to improve operational efficiency.
Provide third-line network support and act as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
Coordinate with ISPs and service providers to resolve DIA and SIP connectivity issues.
Conduct regular network security assessments and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable cybersecurity standards.
Maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, security policies, and troubleshooting records.
Develop technical playbooks, conduct root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvement.
Utilize Power BI to develop infrastructure dashboards and performance reports.
Provide technical guidance to vendors and service providers and optimize infrastructure resources.
Provide 24/7 support for critical network incidents, remotely or on-site when required.
